title: TRACE evidence fragment record (M0)
description: One contiguous byte range of the source media. Frozen fragment ID contract: FRG-<16 lowercase hex>-<start>-<end>. Only contract-frozen field names appear here.

fragment_id.description: FRG-<first 16 lowercase hex of bytes_sha256>-<start>-<end>. The source range is part of the ID, so identical bytes at different source ranges receive different fragment IDs.

byte_range.description: [start, end) byte offsets into the source media.

size_bytes.description: end - start. This is a FRAGMENT size, not media.size_bytes.

bytes_sha256.description: Authoritative content digest of the fragment bytes.

warnings.description: Partial failures affecting this fragment. Never silently omitted.
